description: This file defines the interface for an object ID set data structure, providing functions for initializing, manipulating, and querying a set of object identifiers, as well as parsing object IDs from a file. It appears to be part of a larger codebase related to Git object management.

classes.name: struct oidset
classes.description: A structure representing a set of object IDs backed by a hash table, used for efficient storage and retrieval of object identifiers.

methods.name: oidset_init
methods.description: Initializes an oidset, optionally preallocating space based on initial_size.

methods.name: oidset_contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific object ID is present in the set.

methods.name: oidset_insert
methods.description: Inserts a new object ID into the set, making a copy of it.

methods.name: oidset_insert_from_set
methods.description: Inserts all object IDs from one set into another.

methods.name: oidset_remove
methods.description: Removes a specified object ID from the set.

methods.name: int oidset_size(const struct oidset * set)
methods.description: Returns the number of object IDs in the set.

methods.name: oidset_clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the set, freeing resources.

methods.name: oidset_parse_file
methods.description: Populates the set with object IDs parsed from a file.

methods.name: oidset_parse_file_carefully
methods.description: Similar to parse_file but with a callback for more controlled parsing.

methods.name: void oidset_iter_init(const struct oidset * set,struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for traversing the set.

methods.name: struct:object_id * oidset_iter_next(struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Returns the next object ID in the iteration.

methods.name: struct:object_id * oidset_iter_first(struct oidset * set,struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the first element in the set.
